name: invoke_capability
description: Fallback outlet (ADR-018, state-gated): call ONE classic tool by exact name (list: code_query mode=capabilities). args = that tool's own arguments; top-level workspace_dir/task_id override nested ones; delegates once, result preserved. Side effects: terminal guard + task ledger; request_id consumed (replay/conflict). Success != verified.

name.description: Exact original tool name (see code_query mode=capabilities).

args.description: Original tool arguments per its schema; nested workspace_dir/task_id are ignored.

task_id.description: Optional task to associate (must belong to workspace_dir).

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key consumed by the outlet for side-effect calls: same id + same payload → deduplicated replay (no re-execution); different payload → request_conflict.
